classificationPolicy.consequenceRule: Binary protected/discretionary classification required by #662. Ambiguous lanes are conservatively protected until explicit evidence proves discretionary suppression is safe.
classificationPolicy.behaviorAuthority: Inventory classification alone does not authorize disabling, deleting, or moving required checks.

postSnapshotChanges.change: added .github/workflows/longmemeval-competitive.yml (PR #666, #640 lane v2) under the Phase 0 exception; renamed amb-evidence-import.yml to 'Import same-harness lane evidence' with a lane input instead of a second import workflow

#662 Phases 2-4 landed (docs/plan-662-ci-cost-phases-2-4.md; merge commit recorded in META_LEDGER): push triggers restricted to branches: [main] in 41 workflows, the unpatterned full-suite step deleted from nine workflows, a concurrency block on all 81 PR/push workflows (71 cancel a superseded PR head, 10 complete every run), timeout-minutes on all 77 previously untimed jobs. The mechanical fields (triggers, pathScope, timeoutState, concurrencyState) and the summary counts are now re-synced from the YAML by scripts/sync_workflow_inventory.py; pathScope gains the value "branches" (push restricted to main without paths), which the Phase 1 snapshot did not use. The intended estate is data/github-actions-workflow-policy.json, enforced by reference/tests/test_github_actions_workflow_policy.py.

added .github/workflows/semantic-representation.yml (#669): installs the optional extra 'semantic', fetches the pinned model by digest and runs the provider/store/policy/facade tests with AGENT_MEMORY_REQUIRE_REPRESENTATION=1

longmemeval-competitive.yml (#669 lanes -v3): lane input gains longmemeval-s-retrieval-parity-v3 (default), backend gains agent_memory_semantic (installs the semantic extra under reference/requirements-semantic.txt and fetches the pinned model for that row only), job timeout 180 -> 240 minutes; amb-competitive.yml lane input gains amb-precisionmembench-retrieval-v3 (default)

#662 quiet staging/benchmark fan-out: six independently inventoried discretionary async-assurance benchmark workflows moved from unfiltered PR plus main push to manual workflow_dispatch only. Their names, jobs, pinned evidence, tests, permission, concurrency, explicit timeouts and artifact upload logic are unchanged. Configuration eliminates six PR run starts and six main push run starts when all previously matched; no billed-minute savings claim.

#662 selective PR+main deduplication: atlas-research-intake, evolveai-multicapability-qualification and hermes-recursive-learning-research retain path-filtered PR and workflow_dispatch, remove duplicate main-push triggers. EvolveAI also removes a broad unittest discover duplicate of the protected doctrine umbrella while keeping focused native/provider/source tests. No changed workflow names or job IDs; no equivalence/accepted-revision claims.

#662 bounded discretionary artifacts: exact actions/upload-artifact retention 30d for five manual benchmark evidence workflows, 90d for component/Hindsight independent qualification. Ten upload steps now have explicit retention; remaining 40 uploads lack explicit retention and require source-citation/evidence review. Protected artifact retention left unchanged. sync_workflow_inventory now derives upload-artifact retention and missing-step count directly from YAML.

#662 full source audit reconciled all 86 committed workflows' upload-artifact steps against the inventory: 50 upload steps STILL lack an explicit retention-days setting, due to previously stale pre-2026-10-09 summary count (the added ten explicit retention settings are real; earlier starting count was not accurate). semantic-representation.yml was incorrectly marked as uploading an artifact, but has zero upload steps; corrected. No protected upload step was shortened.
